module origen_131264 (
    input [65535:0] in,
    input [15:0] sel,
    output [15:0] out
);

    wire [15:0] mux_out;
    
    mux_65536to1 main_mux (
        .in(in),
        .sel(sel),
        .out(mux_out)
    );
    
    xor_16bit xor_module (
        .in(mux_out),
        .out(out)
    );

endmodule

module mux_65536to1 (
    input [65535:0] in,
    input [15:0] sel,
    output [15:0] out
);

    wire [15:0] level1_out [0:3];

    genvar i;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < 4; i = i + 1) begin : mux_16384to1
            mux_16384to1 mux_l1 (
                .in(in[16384*i +: 16384]),
                .sel(sel[13:0]),
                .out(level1_out[i])
            );
        end
    endgenerate

    mux_4to1_16bit final_mux (
        .in0(level1_out[0]),
        .in1(level1_out[1]),
        .in2(level1_out[2]),
        .in3(level1_out[3]),
        .sel(sel[15:14]),
        .out(out)
    );

endmodule

);

        .in3(level1_out[3]),

endmodule

    input [9:0] sel,
    output [15:0] out
);

    genvar i;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < 4; i = i + 1) begin : mux_256to1
            mux_256to1 mux_l1 (

module mux_256to1 (
    input [255:0] in,

    genvar i;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1) begin : mux_16to1
            mux_16to1 mux_l1 (
                .in(in[16*i +: 16]),
                .sel(sel[3:0]),

        .in(level1_out),
        .sel(sel[7:4]),
        .out(out)

module mux_16to1 (
    input [15:0] in,
    input [3:0] sel,
    output out
);

    assign out = in[sel];

endmodule

module mux_16to1_16bit (
    input [15:0] in [0:15],
    input [3:0] sel,
    output [15:0] out
);

    assign out = in[sel];

endmodule

module mux_4to1_16bit (
    input [15:0] in0, in1, in2, in3,
    input [1:0] sel,
    output [15:0] out
);

    assign out = (sel == 2'b00) ? in0 :
                 (sel == 2'b01) ? in1 :
                 (sel == 2'b10) ? in2 : in3;

endmodule

module xor_16bit (
    input [15:0] in,
    output [15:0] out
);

    assign out = in ^ 16'hFFFF;

endmodule
